title: BillFlow-AI
summary: A full-stack billing and sales management platform for a manufacturing enterprise, with invoice automation, inventory tracking, and a machine-learning demand-forecasting module. Its ML pipeline calls SDV's CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic sales samples that augment sparse historical data before training a Random Forest demand predictor.
evidence: backend/ml_model.py: `synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=150, batch_size=500, verbose=False,` using sdv.single_table and sdv.metadata imports
needs: confirm whether SDV-generated samples are actually merged into training data downstream (only synthesizer construction shown in evidence)
